subject: Kickoff: Lighthouse relighting primitive
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off Lighthouse. Our open-source release predicts incident illumination at any 3D location in a scene: a narrow-baseline stereo pair of RGB images goes in, a multiscale RGBA lighting volume comes out, and spatially-varying lighting falls out of standard volume rendering. Product framing for data-platforms: a relighting primitive in the imaging pipeline, so downstream teams can composite objects into customer scenes with plausible lighting.

Milestones:
- Mar 27: pretrained model running on the InteriorNet test set via interiornet_test.py (checkpoint_dir/data_dir/output_dir flags wired to our storage).
- Apr 24: retraining path validated with train.py on our own interior captures.
- May 22: integration demo with the imaging pipeline team.

Santiago owns staffing. Yusuf is research lead. Flag: the release notes say parts of the original code depend on non-Apache external codebases — Yusuf, please scope that first, it may constrain what we ship.

Dmitri
